Tautulli attributes have now been moved to their own sensors. Please review any automations or scripts that you may have and adjust those accordingly.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

A user has been using some undocumented Tautulli attributes before the update on Config Flow.
This PR adds those in but is not ideal from a database standpoint.
A future update is planned to make these individual sensors.

issue_context.title: Tautulli Integration Missing Monitored Conditions
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When the Tautulli integration was moved from a YAML to a UI config, the migration did not include the `monitored_conditions` portion of the integration. There also seems to be no way to set this configuration via the UI either.

**YAML Config with Monitored Conditions**
```
- platform: tautulli
  api_key: !secret tautulli_api_key
  host: !secret tautulli_host
  monitored_conditions:
    - friendly_name
    - full_title
    - progress_percent
    - stream_video_resolution
    - transcode_decision
    - user_thumb
    - video_resolution
```

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.5.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.4.7

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Tautulli

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tautulli/

This was intentional. The plan is to split these into individual sensors which can then be disabled via the UI.

That sounds great, but I'm assuming by plan you're implying these individual sensors are not part of the 2022.5 update, right? If that's accurate, do you have an ETA? I would have refrained from updating had I realized I was about to lose functionality.

Well when you put it that way, that was not the intention. Looks like only the documented attributes were carried over. This PR may get rejected as it is not database friendly. If closed, you can put this modified integration in `custom_components`. To answer your question, no ETA like everything else here. Too much to do

The example I included in the description only includes the additional data points I personally use. My understanding, based on memory since the documentation has changed, is that the `monitored_conditions` prop could be passed any data point included in the [get_activity](https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/wiki/Tautulli-API-Reference#get_activity) call from the API.
